title: Clip a brush
summary: Cut selected brushes with a line drawn in a grid view.
outcome: The selected brush is cut on the intended side of a plane.

sections.title: Preview and apply a cut

steps.title: Select and enter Clip
steps.text: Select one or more whole brushes, then activate Clip brushes (X).

steps.title: Draw the cut
steps.text: Left-drag a line through the brush in an orthographic view. The line previews a cutting plane through the view; left and right follow the direction in which you drew the line.

steps.title: Choose the result
steps.text: Choose Split both, Keep left, or Keep right in the Clip control, then click Apply or press Enter. Inspect the result in Camera and Undo if the side was wrong.

tips: Click Cancel or press Esc to discard a preview before applying. A zero-length drag gives no cut; draw a clear line through the selected brush.
